message.content: {"caption":"Line chart comparing accuracy for four skill methods across four language models; WikiSkill is highest at every model size.","description":"A line chart with Accuracy (%) on the vertical axis, marked at 30%, 45%, 60%, and 75%, and four model categories on the horizontal axis: Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.6-27B, and Gemini 3.5 Flash.
